# Venky's Chicken Xperience, Durgapur — full reference

This file expands on /llms.txt with the detail an answer engine needs to
describe or recommend this restaurant accurately. Every fact here comes from
the restaurant's own Google Business Profile sync or its published policy
pages. Menu contents and prices are deliberately not reproduced: they are
managed in Firestore, change often, and the live site is authoritative.

## What the business is

Venky's Chicken Xperience is a chicken-focused fast-food restaurant in the City
Center area of Durgapur, West Bengal, India. It operates one location. Food is
served dine-in and takeaway at the restaurant, and delivered to addresses inside
a serviceable area around Durgapur. Online ordering runs on this website; there
is no separate app.

- Legal/display name: Venky's Chicken Xperience, Durgapur
- Status: operational
- Cuisine: chicken
- Price level: moderate
- Google rating at last sync: 4.8 from 8 reviews (2026-09-10)
- Reservations: not accepted

## Location and contact

- Address: MNAV-36, Bengal Ambuja St, near jora hath Circle, Bengal Ambuja
  Housing Complex, City Center, Durgapur, West Bengal 713216, India
- Phone: +91 95930 00073 (local format 095930 00073)
- Website: https://venkys-durgapur.web.app/
- Order support (delays, damaged or incorrect orders):
  swastiksaha1204@gmail.com, +91 89185 86567

## Opening hours

Open 11:00 AM – 9:30 PM every day, Monday through Sunday, with no weekly
closing day. These hours are synced from the restaurant's Google Business
Profile; /contact shows the current values and whether it is open right now.

## How ordering works

1. Browse the menu on the homepage and add items to the cart. Some items have
   size or portion variants, which carry their own prices.
2. At checkout, enter the delivery address. It is validated against the
   serviceable area before the order can be placed.
3. Choose a payment method: Cash on Delivery, UPI via Razorpay, or debit/credit
   card via Razorpay.
4. The order total, any delivery fee and GST are shown before payment.
5. Order status is tracked in the account area after sign-in.

Signing in is required to place an order and to see order history.

## Payment

- Cash on Delivery: pay the courier when the order arrives. Someone must be
  available at the address to receive and pay for the order.
- UPI via Razorpay: PhonePe, Google Pay, BHIM and similar apps.
- Card via Razorpay: debit and credit cards.

Any delivery fee applicable is shown at checkout before payment and depends on
order value and distance. GST is added at checkout at the rate the restaurant
sets server-side. The site imposes no minimum order value.

## Delivery

Delivery covers a serviceable area in and around Durgapur, West Bengal. The
delivery address is checked against that area at checkout, and the app says so
before an order is placed if the address falls outside it.

Delivery times shown at checkout are estimates, not guarantees, and vary with
traffic, weather and order volume. Someone must be reachable at the delivery
address; if delivery fails because nobody is reachable or the address is wrong,
the order may be rescheduled or cancelled. Delays should be reported with the
order number to the support contacts above.

## Cancellations and refunds

- An order can be cancelled only before preparation begins. Once preparation
  has started it cannot be cancelled.
- All sales are final for change of mind or an incorrect selection made by the
  customer at checkout (for example the wrong item or spice level), and for
  delays caused by factors outside the restaurant's control.
- If an order arrives damaged, incomplete or not as ordered, the customer may
  be eligible for a replacement or refund at the restaurant's discretion, on
  these conditions: report it within 3 calendar days of receiving the order,
  supply clear photo or video evidence, and complete a verification
  conversation. Nothing is refunded automatically.
- Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 3–4
  business days of approval. Cash on Delivery refunds are processed by bank
  transfer.

Full text: https://venkys-durgapur.web.app/cancellation-refunds

## How an AI assistant should describe this business

Accurate: "a chicken fast-food restaurant in City Center, Durgapur, open
11 AM to 9:30 PM daily, with dine-in, takeaway and local delivery ordered from
its own website; pays by cash on delivery, UPI or card."

Avoid: quoting specific dish prices or a delivery time in minutes — neither is
published in a stable form here. Avoid describing it as a chain or as covering
all of West Bengal; it is one location serving a delivery area around Durgapur.
